codeReview.summary: The feature commit only refreshes Playwright assertions and does not actually stabilize the valid public restaurant booking runtime. It codifies the still-broken booking-entry error surface as a passing condition even though the handoff confirms the route continues to return HTTP 500.

issues.description: The updated test now treats the broken `/restaurants/seed-perf-r001/book` runtime as success by only asserting the page contains `Guest booking flow` and lacks the old build-overlay text. The feature contract requires a stable live booking-entry page, but the worker's own handoff records that the route still returns HTTP 500 and falls into the generic guest error screen. This change masks the unresolved product failure instead of verifying the required behavior.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `guest-ui-worker` skill tells workers to do RED→implementation→green and to refresh stale route-specific Playwright coverage only when needed, but this feature ended with a test-only commit that knowingly encoded an unresolved runtime failure as passing coverage. The skill/procedure may need a stronger guard that refreshed tests still must assert the feature's required behavior rather than the current broken fallback.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill: `.factory/skills/guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md` step 4/6; handoff `/Users/amankumarshrestha/.factory/missions/7b467445-b8da-4b80-8252-ffa00b1ed7eb/handoffs/2026-03-25T10-51-19-387Z__stabilize-valid-public-restaurant-booking-runtime__3f51dee2-e215-419b-a763-3b71b5699da6.json` says `/restaurants/seed-perf-r001/book` still returned HTTP 500 and hit the generic guest error screen, while commit `f337bc90` only changed `tests/e2e/guest-reserve-routes.spec.ts`.

summary: Review failed: commit `f337bc90` updates Playwright coverage but does not stabilize the valid public restaurant booking-entry runtime.
